artifacts.backend_detail: hand-written CUDA + inline PTX (load_inline, sm_89). algo=K3, head_dim=128, tile: QK 128x128x32/256thr; softmax 1 row/block x 128thr; PV 128x128x32/256thr (mma). QK^T: Q,K read fp32 from global and converted with cvt.rn.f16x2.f32 into shared memory, then mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16.row.col.f32.f16.f16.f32 with A via ldmatrix.sync.aligned.m8n8.x4.shared.b16 and B via a plain (non-.trans) ldmatrix.x2 on K in its native (seq,d) layout; fp32 accumulator. score_dtype=fp16: the fp32 mma accumulator is scaled by 1/sqrt(d) and rounded through __float2half_rn before the softmax reads it; S is materialized in global memory in that dtype. prob_dtype=fp16: P -> ldmatrix.x4 A fragment of mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16.row.col.f32.f16.f16.f32; V converted fp32->fp16 by cvt.rn.f16x2.f32 on the global->shared path and read by ldmatrix.x2.trans / ldmatrix.x4.trans. The mma accumulator is fp32 in every cell. softmax is a separate kernel over the materialized 512-wide rows (128 thr x 4 elements cached in registers, __shfl_xor_sync + a per-warp smem tree); it runs in place when sdtype==pdtype
